about: Sources and phase corrections for consumables. The key is the consumable. Sold, quest, drops and found fill gaps in the recipe data. Source and origin override a verified source, and phase gates entries whose acquisition depends on future content or lacks confirmation. See docs/audit-forever/consommables-enchantements-2026-11-25.md.
